where do i set the default url for google chrome

To set the default URL (homepage or startup page) for Google Chrome, follow these steps:

1. Click the three-dot menu (⋮) in the top-right corner of Chrome.
2. Select “Settings.”
3. In the left menu, click on “On startup.”
4. Choose “Open a specific page or set of pages.”
5. Click “Add a new page” and enter the URL you want as your default.
6. Remove any unwanted pages from the list.

You can also set your homepage (the page that opens when you click the home button):

1. In “Settings,” go to “Appearance.”
2. Turn on “Show Home button.”
3. Enter your preferred URL in the field provided.
